exposure: Cesarean sections (as a risk factor suggested for reduction)
cohort: The study reviewed 747,077 pregnancies and all childbirth records where maternal mortality occurred from 2002 to 2012 in Fars Province, Iran.
finding: The average maternal mortality rate (MMR) was 21.28 per 100,000 live births per year, with maternal hemorrhage being the most common cause (27%).
mod_finding: Recommendations include the reduction of cesarean sections to positively impact MMR, suggesting CS as a potential risk factor.
